_comment: Lightning 2.0 Phase 1, cash session / cluster integration, no matcher. cash_games gains cluster_mode (CHECK cash_games_cluster_mode_check over the ten Cluster states, default must_move), lightning_enabled (default false) and cluster_epoch (default 0, CHECK >= 0). cash_player_session gains a nullable cluster_id, backfilled from tables.cluster_id, with partial index cash_player_session_open_by_cluster. fn_cash_session_open is re-created with cluster_id in its INSERT column list; body and three-argument signature otherwise unchanged. New reader fn_cash_cluster_lightning_state(uuid) RETURNS jsonb, STABLE SECURITY DEFINER, service_role only. No runtime behaviour changes: every default is what every existing cluster already is.
